Shepherd’s salad: Dice the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper and onion small.
Mix the olive oil and lemon juice and add to the salad.
Seed the pomegranate and roughly break the walnuts.
Mix the rocket with the pomegranate and walnuts.
Serve with olive oil and lemon.
Boil the chickpeas fully and let them cool.
Chop the parsley, cucumber and onion.
Combine all the ingredients in a bowl.
Mix with oil and lemon and serve.
Rinse the lentils, boil in plenty of water until soft and drain.
Finely chop the parsley and pepper.
Once the lentils have cooled, mix them with the vegetables.
Season with olive oil and lemon.
Rinse the quinoa well, cook in the water for 15 minutes and let cool.
Chop the cucumber, tomatoes and parsley.
Combine the quinoa with the vegetables.
Toss with lemon and olive oil.
Wash and dry the lettuce and vegetables thoroughly.
Chop the cucumber and tomatoes; drain the tuna.
Combine the vegetables, corn and tuna in a bowl.
Mix with olive oil and lemon juice and serve.
Soak the bulgur in hot water, cover and leave for 15 minutes.
Finely chop the tomatoes, cucumber and mint.
Fluff the bulgur with a fork and mix with the vegetables.
Add lemon juice and olive oil and serve.
Wash the beetroots and boil them in their skins for 35-45 minutes until soft.
Mix the yogurt with crushed garlic and add the beetroot.
Serve with olive oil and walnuts.
Finely shred the cabbage and grate the carrot.
Lightly rub the cabbage with lemon juice.
Whisk the yogurt and olive oil and toss with the vegetables.
Wash the purslane in plenty of water and dry thoroughly.
Whisk the yogurt with crushed garlic.
Gently mix the purslane with the yogurt.
Trim the ends of the beans and wash them.
Soften the onion in olive oil and add the chopped tomatoes.
Add the beans and hot water.
Cook over low heat for 35-40 minutes until the beans are soft.
Chop the onion and sauté in oil.
Cut the zucchini into half-moons and add with the tomatoes.
Add the washed rice and the water.
Cook for about 25 minutes until the zucchini and rice are soft.
Dice the eggplants, soak in salted water for 15 minutes and rinse.
Brown the onion and minced meat in a pan until the meat is fully cooked.
Add the tomatoes and eggplants and pour in the water.
Cook covered for 25 minutes until the eggplants are soft.
Preheat the oven to 190°C; separate the cauliflower into florets.
Pre-cook the cauliflower in steam for 8 minutes.
Whisk the yogurt and egg and toss with the cauliflower.
Sprinkle the cheese on top and bake for 20 minutes until golden.
Wash the spinach several times and chop roughly.
Soften the onion in the oil.
Add the spinach, washed rice and water.
Cook for 20 minutes until the rice is soft and the spinach fully cooked.
Wash the okra and trim the stems into a cone shape.
Soften the onion in oil and add the grated tomatoes.
Add the okra, lemon juice and water.
Cook covered for 25-30 minutes until the okra is soft.
Wash the leeks well and slice into rings; slice the carrots.
Sauté the carrots in olive oil for 3 minutes.
Add the leeks, washed rice and water.
Cook over low heat for 25-30 minutes and serve with lemon.
Artichokes and peas in olive oil
Chop the onion and dice the carrot.
Sauté the onion and carrot in olive oil for 4 minutes.
Add the artichokes and peas and pour in the lemon water.
Cook covered for 25-30 minutes until the artichokes are soft.
Peas and carrots in olive oil
Finely chop the onion; dice the carrot and potato.
Sauté the onion in oil for 3 minutes.
Add the carrot, potato and peas and stir.
Add the hot water and cook covered for 25-30 minutes until the vegetables are soft.
Peel the vegetables and slice them to an even thickness.
Toss with oil and thyme and spread in a single layer on a tray.
Bake for 30-40 minutes, turning occasionally, until soft and golden.
Soak the beans overnight and drain.
Pre-boil the beans in fresh water for 20 minutes and drain.
Fry the onion in oil; add the tomato paste and stir for 1 minute.
Add the beans and hot water; cook for 45-60 minutes until the beans are completely soft.
